lessons.Meetings, messages and asking for help: Meetings, messages and asking for help
lessons.Recognise the key words, hear them and s: Recognise the key words, hear them and say them clearly.
lessons.Practise the question and response, then: Practise the question and response, then put a useful sentence in order.
lessons.Listen for the important words and detai: Listen for the important words and details before choosing an answer.
lessons.Read a short text and find evidence for: Read a short text and find evidence for your answer.
lessons.Respond to six prompts. Listen again and: Respond to six prompts. Listen again and try without reading the model.
lessons.Understand a practical text, build sente: Understand a practical text, build sentences and create your own version offline.
lessons.Recall useful language and check reading: Recall useful language and check reading, listening and sentence order.
lessons.Check the destination, direction and dep: Check the destination, direction and departure time separately. Practise the polite request as a whole phrase.
lessons.Answer, add one detail and ask a questio: Answer, add one detail and ask a question back. Follow the model's level of politeness; names and personal details can be fictional.
lessons.Make the request clear and confirm the t: Make the request clear and confirm the time or deadline. Use a greeting and a closing in a message. Children can act out a school project.
lessons.Make six word cards. Say a word and find: Make six word cards. Say a word and find its card; younger learners may draw with an adult.
lessons.Swap roles with a partner. Change one pl: Swap roles with a partner. Change one place, time or personal detail and repeat the exchange.
lessons.Listen, pause, repeat and compare. Keep: Listen, pause, repeat and compare. Keep words clear; speed is not the goal.
lessons.Point to the words that prove each answe: Point to the words that prove each answer. Read the text aloud once more.
Act out the exchange without the screen. Ask a partner to check whether your meaning is clear.
lessons.Draw a route and write a departure notic: Draw a route and write a departure notice with a destination and time. Older learners add a platform and return date. Ask a partner to follow it.
lessons.Create a fictional profile with a name,: Create a fictional profile with a name, place and interest. Add an invitation and practise a friendly goodbye. Younger learners can dictate or draw.
lessons.Write a message with a greeting, purpose: Write a message with a greeting, purpose, meeting time, requested action and closing. Read it to a partner. Children can invite their team to a school activity.
lessons.Try again tomorrow without the model. A: Try again tomorrow without the model. A partner or teacher should review your original writing; the app checks only the model sentence order.
lessons.Which sport does the person play?: Which sport does the person play?
lessons.On which day can the speaker finish?: On which day can the speaker finish?
lessons.Find the matching detail in the passage,: Find the matching detail in the passage, then read the whole sentence again.

lessons.Introductions, interests and making plan: 自我介紹、興趣與相約見面
lessons.Meetings, messages and asking for help: 約定時間、傳遞訊息與求助
lessons.Recognise the key words, hear them and s: 認識關鍵詞，聆聽並清楚說出。
lessons.Practise the question and response, then: 練習問題及回答，再按順序組成實用句子。
lessons.Listen for the important words and detai: 先聽出關鍵詞及細節，再選答案。
lessons.Read a short text and find evidence for: 閱讀短文，找出支持答案的內容。
lessons.Respond to six prompts. Listen again and: 回應六個提示。再聽一次，嘗試不看範例回答。
lessons.Understand a practical text, build sente: 理解實用短文，組句，再離線寫出自己的版本。
lessons.Recall useful language and check reading: 回想實用表達，檢查閱讀、聆聽及句子順序。
lessons.Check the destination, direction and dep: 分別確認目的地、方向及出發時間。把禮貌請求當作完整語句練習。
lessons.Answer, add one detail and ask a questio: 先回答，加一項細節，再問對方一個問題。留意範例的禮貌程度；可使用虛構姓名及資料。
lessons.Make the request clear and confirm the t: 清楚提出請求，確認時間或期限。訊息要有開首問候和結尾。兒童可用學校專題作情境。
lessons.Make six word cards. Say a word and find: 製作六張詞卡，說出詞語並找出相應卡片；幼童可與成人一起畫圖。
lessons.Swap roles with a partner. Change one pl: 與同伴交換角色，改一個地點、時間或個人資料，再練習對話。
lessons.Listen, pause, repeat and compare. Keep: 聽、停、重複，再比較。以清楚表達為目標，不用追求速度。
lessons.Point to the words that prove each answe: 指出支持每個答案的詞語，再朗讀一次短文。
不看螢幕演練對話，請同伴確認意思是否清楚。
lessons.Draw a route and write a departure notic: 畫路線，寫目的地及出發時間；年長學習者加上站台和回程日期，請同伴按資料行動。
lessons.Create a fictional profile with a name,: 創作虛構人物，寫姓名、居住地及興趣，加上邀請和道別；幼童可口述或畫圖。
lessons.Write a message with a greeting, purpose: 寫一則有問候、目的、時間、請求和結尾的訊息，讀給同伴聽；兒童可邀請組員參加學校活動。
lessons.Try again tomorrow without the model. A: 明天不看範例再試。原創寫作請同伴或老師回饋；應用程式只檢查範例句的順序。
lessons.Find the matching detail in the passage,: 在短文找出相應細節，再讀一次完整句子。

lessons.Meetings, messages and asking for help: 约定时间、传递讯息与求助
lessons.Recognise the key words, hear them and s: 认识关键词，聆听并清楚说出。
lessons.Practise the question and response, then: 练习问题及回答，再按顺序组成实用句子。
lessons.Listen for the important words and detai: 先听出关键词及细节，再选答案。
lessons.Read a short text and find evidence for: 阅读短文，找出支持答案的内容。
lessons.Respond to six prompts. Listen again and: 回应六个提示。再听一次，尝试不看范例回答。
lessons.Understand a practical text, build sente: 理解实用短文，组句，再离线写出自己的版本。
lessons.Recall useful language and check reading: 回想实用表达，检查阅读、聆听及句子顺序。
lessons.Check the destination, direction and dep: 分别确认目的地、方向及出发时间。把礼貌请求当作完整语句练习。
lessons.Answer, add one detail and ask a questio: 先回答，加一项细节，再问对方一个问题。留意范例的礼貌程度；可使用虚构姓名及资料。
lessons.Make the request clear and confirm the t: 清楚提出请求，确认时间或期限。讯息要有开首问候和结尾。儿童可用学校专题作情境。
lessons.Make six word cards. Say a word and find: 制作六张词卡，说出词语并找出相应卡片；幼童可与成人一起画图。
lessons.Swap roles with a partner. Change one pl: 与同伴交换角色，改一个地点、时间或个人资料，再练习对话。
lessons.Listen, pause, repeat and compare. Keep: 听、停、重复，再比较。以清楚表达为目标，不用追求速度。
lessons.Point to the words that prove each answe: 指出支持每个答案的词语，再朗读一次短文。
不看萤幕演练对话，请同伴确认意思是否清楚。
lessons.Draw a route and write a departure notic: 画路线，写目的地及出发时间；年长学习者加上站台和回程日期，请同伴按资料行动。
lessons.Create a fictional profile with a name,: 创作虚构人物，写姓名、居住地及兴趣，加上邀请和道别；幼童可口述或画图。
lessons.Write a message with a greeting, purpose: 写一则有问候、目的、时间、请求和结尾的讯息，读给同伴听；儿童可邀请组员参加学校活动。
lessons.Try again tomorrow without the model. A: 明天不看范例再试。原创写作请同伴或老师回馈；应用程式只检查范例句的顺序。
lessons.Find the matching detail in the passage,: 在短文找出相应细节，再读一次完整句子。
